dimensions.assessment: Affects Alaska Native village corporations and residents of those native villages.
Modifies land conveyance obligations and permits trust dissolution upon formal resolution.
Authorizes technical assistance funding without specifying amounts.
Amends Section 14(c) of the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act.
Permanent statutory change to land conveyance requirements.

missing_information: Specific funding amounts for technical assistance
Number of village corporations and acres of land impacted
importance_detail.rationale: Removes requirements for Alaska Native village corporations to convey lands in trust to the State of Alaska and allows dissolution of existing trusts.
